title: learning-block-primitive
intention: THE SHARED GATE MACHINERY every Learning Block imports — built ONCE, the single-door move: (1) the DOOR: an input-contract check that refuses insufficient shape with the lack NAMED, recorded, and sent back; (2) the TRACE: every firing recorded, green included, consumer-typed at write (debug / training / tree-primary) — no consumer named, no trace written; debug traces expire untouched at 30 days, SWEPT BY THE NEXT WRITE (the write is the event; no clock, no daemon); (3) the FINDING: a bullet-list emitted at exit, each bullet stratum-tagged (code / tree / Hex); (4) the VERDICT: Akien's approve/disprove/question captured as a labeled training pair to CairnCommons/learning/ — approvals counted too, the denominator; (5) the DIAL: per-block counters (firings, send-backs, approvals, disproves, prediction-match rate) projected from the trace, never a second copy.
why: Akien, 2026-08-01: 'our workflow itself must have the same hard gates, built of learning blocks, everywhere... learning blocks can send a task or whatever back if the inputs are not sufficient AT ALL STEPS. that has been the problem all along.' And the gate design settled the same morning: 'we start with me owning all gates and i approve the pass... a bullet list finding from an inspector for that step that learns what --I-- will gate. eventually i delegate it.' One primitive rather than N bespoke gates is the db_domain single-door pattern; the skills then declare contracts, not mechanisms. Full arc + challenge pass: notes/held-learning-blocks-everywhere.json.
traces_to: Law 1 — the gate machinery is written once and imported, never re-derived per skill
Law 3 — a verdict is a recorded measurement; greens are the denominator that makes yield computable (the Leah rule)
Law 4 — send-back is physics at the door, not discipline in CC's memory; expiry is write-fired, never a clock
Law 6 — Akien owns every gate at the start; delegation happens only through his act, never ambiently
Law 7 — a refusal names its lack; a trace without a consumer is refused at write
founding intention learns-its-gates (gate-records to CairnCommons/learning/ — this builds that store's writer)

proves_green.prove_gate: proof gate — the tester runs the node's proof and emits a VALIDATION.
proves_green.durability_gate: not done until tested AND durably committed (git).

falsifier.proves_red: RED, by physics, on any of: (1) the door passes an input missing a declared-required field, or refuses without NAMING the lack; (2) a trace is written with no consumer type, or a firing leaves no trace at all — including a GREEN firing (the denominator must exist); (3) the expiry sweep deletes a trace under 30 days old, touches a non-debug trace, or requires anything resident to run (a clock-fired sweep is the daemon drift this system rejects); (4) a verdict is recorded without its bullet-list context (an unlabeled training pair teaches nothing), or an approval is dropped as not-worth-recording; (5) the dial holds state of its own instead of projecting from the trace (a second copy of the truth, Law 6); (6) a bullet carries no stratum tag (an adjudication whose provenance is invisible cannot be delegated).
falsifier.horizon: Re-read at the first delegation: the moment Akien hands a gate to a trained inspector, the primitive needs the delegated-verdict path (inspector rules, Akien audits) — deliberately NOT built now; nothing is delegated on day one by design.
